params.name: privKey
params.description: BLOB to receive the generated private key

params.name: pubKey
params.description: BLOB to receive the generated public key

params.name: length
params.description: Key length in bits, in the range 512...2048

overloads.semanticRole: Generates a new RSA key pair, returning the private and public keys in privKey and pubKey, at the requested key length (default 512 bits).

constraints: Larger key sizes are harder to break but require more computation; length must be chosen accordingly.
